about_the_game:
Play as Sae on her journey to find her place in the world. A next generation Metroidvania that combines challenging combat, thrilling platforming, intricate puzzles, and emotional storytelling to provide a whole new way to experience this story.

Game Features:

  • A next generation Metroidvania that combines combat, platforming, and puzzles with a strong narrative focus

  • Bringing traditional 2D side scroller controls, looks and feels to 3D with tightly tuned 2D controls

  • Slash your way through even the most deadly enemies

  • Use different melee attacks with unique attack combos to get the upper hand

  • Special range attacks aid you in battle

  • Explore different regions with vastly different environment designs

  • Player paths bring 3D exploration to 2D side scroller mechanics without losing the traditional charm

  • Upgrade your weapons, skills, and player stats

  • Interact with various NPCs that react to your decisions and behaviour

short_description: Become water. Be shapeless, be formless, be fluid. All living things are from water and you can transform water into what it needs to be. Dive into this newly crafted fairytale and take on the journey of finding your place in this Metroidvania fantasy world.
